**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/17 (Fri) 08:14
- [EVENT] User inquired about the name of the war that occurred in the last 100 days of World War I.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The war that took place in the last 100 days of World War I is called the Battle of Amiens.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Battle of Amiens occurred from August 8 to August 11, 1918.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Battle of Amiens was a significant victory for the Allies, marking the beginning of the end of World War I.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The battle was characterized by the use of tanks, which played a crucial role in breaking through German lines.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The battle is also notable for the participation of Australian, Canadian, American, French, and British troops.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The victory in the Battle of Amiens led to the signing of the Armistice on November 11, 1918, which ended World War I.
